#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf.

Since no report.pdf exists in the workspace, this script first creates a sample
financial report PDF, then prepends a generated cover page, saving the result as
report.pdf (cover first, report content after).
"""
import datetime
import os
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter


def esc(text):
    return text.replace("\\", r"\\").replace("(", r"\(").replace(")", r"\)")


# Minimal Helvetica width table (standard AFM widths for common characters)
HELVETICA_WIDTHS = {
    " ": 278, "!": 278, '"': 355, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 667,
    "'": 191, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 278, ";": 278,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 556, "@": 1015, "A": 667, "B": 667,
    "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778, "H": 722, "I": 278,
    "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667,
    "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944,
    "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611, "[": 278, "\\": 278, "]": 278, "^": 469,
    "_": 556, "`": 333, "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556,
    "f": 278, "g": 556, "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222,
    "m": 833, "n": 556, "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500,
    "t": 278, "u": 556, "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
    "{": 334, "|": 260, "}": 334, "~": 584,
}


def text_width(text, font_size):
    return sum(HELVETICA_WIDTHS.get(ch, 500) for ch in text) * font_size / 1000.0


def center_x(text, font_size):
    return (PAGE_W - text_width(text, font_size)) / 2.0


def build_single_page_pdf(objects_builder, filename):
    """Write a minimal single-page PDF built from a list of content lines."""
    objects = objects_builder()
    out = bytearray()
    out += b"%PDF-1.4\n"

    offsets = {}
    for num, body in objects:
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode("ascii")
        out += body
        out += b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    count = len(objects) + 1
    out += f"xref\n0 {count}\n".encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in sorted(offsets):
        out += f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii")

    out += f"trailer\n<< /Size {count} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode("ascii")

    with open(filename, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))
    return filename


def make_cover_page_pdf(filename, title, date_str):
    """Create a single-page cover PDF with a centered title and date."""
    content = []
    content.append("BT /F1 28 Tf 0 0 0 rg")
    x = center_x(title, 28)
    content.append(f"{x:.2f} {PAGE_H - 320:.2f} Td ({esc(title)}) Tj")
    content.append("ET")
    rule_y = PAGE_H - 355
    content.append("0.3 w 0 0 0 RG")
    content.append(f"{(PAGE_W - 300) / 2:.2f} {rule_y:.2f} m {(PAGE_W + 300) / 2:.2f} {rule_y:.2f} l S")
    content.append("BT /F1 16 Tf 0 0 0 rg")
    x = center_x(date_str, 16)
    content.append(f"{x:.2f} {PAGE_H - 400:.2f} Td ({esc(date_str)}) Tj")
    content.append("ET")

    content_stream = "\n".join(content).encode("latin-1")

    def objects():
        return [
            (1, b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>"),
            (2, b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>"),
            (3, b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
                b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"),
            (4, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"),
            (5, b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(content_stream) + content_stream + b"\nendstream"),
        ]

    return build_single_page_pdf(objects, filename)


def make_text_page_pdf(filename, page_num, lines):
    """Create a simple text page for the sample report body."""
    content = []
    content.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 0 0 0 rg")
    y = PAGE_H - 72
    for line in lines:
        content.append(f"72 {y:.2f} Td ({esc(line)}) Tj")
        y -= 20
    content.append("ET")

    content_stream = "\n".join(content).encode("latin-1")

    def objects():
        return [
            (1, b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>"),
            (2, b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>"),
            (3, b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
                b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"),
            (4, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"),
            (5, b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(content_stream) + content_stream + b"\nendstream"),
        ]

    return build_single_page_pdf(objects, filename)


def main():
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    print(f"Cover title: {title!r}")
    print(f"Cover date:  {date_str!r}")

    # 1. Build the sample report body (2 pages)
    page1_lines = [
        "Annual Financial Report - Company XYZ",
        "",
        "Executive Summary",
        "This document provides a summary of the financial performance",
        "for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. All figures are in",
        "thousands of US dollars unless otherwise noted.",
        "",
        "Revenue",
        "Total revenue reached $12,450K, an increase of 8.4% over the",
        "prior year, driven by strong growth in the services segment.",
        "",
        "Expenses",
        "Operating expenses totaled $9,320K, including $2,150K in",
        "research and development and $1,400K in sales and marketing.",
        "",
    ]
    page2_lines = [
        "Net Income",
        "Net income for the year was $3,130K, yielding a net margin of",
        "25.1%. Earnings per share (diluted) were $3.12.",
        "",
        "Balance Sheet Highlights",
        "Total assets: $18,760K",
        "Total liabilities: $9,410K",
        "Shareholders' equity: $9,350K",
        "",
        "Outlook",
        "Management expects continued growth in the coming fiscal year",
        "with a revenue target of $13,800K.",
        "",
        "--- End of Report ---",
    ]

    print("Creating sample report body pages...")
    body_files = []
    for idx, lines in enumerate((page1_lines, page2_lines), start=1):
        fname = f"_report_body_{idx}.pdf"
        make_text_page_pdf(fname, idx, lines)
        body_files.append(fname)

    # 2. Build the cover page
    print("Creating cover page...")
    cover_file = "_cover.pdf"
    make_cover_page_pdf(cover_file, title, date_str)

    # 3. Merge cover + body into final report.pdf
    print("Merging cover page with report body -> report.pdf")
    writer = PdfWriter()
    for fname in [cover_file] + body_files:
        reader = PdfReader(fname)
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)

    with open("report.pdf", "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    # 4. Verify
    final = PdfReader("report.pdf")
    print(f"report.pdf created with {len(final.pages)} pages")
    for i, page in enumerate(final.pages, start=1):
        txt = (page.extract_text() or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
        print(f"  Page {i}: {txt[:100]}")

    for tmp in [cover_file] + body_files:
        os.remove(tmp)
    print("Done.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
